<entry id="D00515">
<head-word>דְּיוֹמַד</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (perh. a perversion of δίδυμος, 
<italic>forked</italic>, cmp. LXX, Josh. VIII, 29; popular etymol.</definition>
<notes> = דְּיוֹ עַמּוּדִין, v. דְּיוֹ II; Erub. 18

<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. נידון משום ד' is considered as a 
<italic>diomad</italic> (two fictitious walls). Y. ib. II, 20
<sup>a</sup> top, opp. פשוט a plain bar; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. דְּיוֹמְדִין</plural-form>. Ib. II, 1 ארבע ד' נראין כשמונה four corner pieces having the appearance of eight bars; a. fr. [דיומדין, Y. Shebi. VII, beg. 37
<sup>b</sup>, v. דִּימוֹרוֹן.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>דְּיוֹקָן</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (a reverential transformation of אִיקוֹן q. v.) 
<italic>image, likeness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 15
<sup>b</sup> דמות דְּיוּקְנִי a likeness of My image (a human life; Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>a</sup> top; Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>a</sup> top איקונין); v. כָּפָה. B. Bath. 58
<sup>a</sup> בדמות דְּיוּקְנִי … דְּיוֹקְנִי עצמה וכ' thou hast been permitted to see the likeness of My image (Abraham), but My image itself (Adam) &c. Ḥull. 91
<sup>b</sup> דְּיוּקְנוֹ של מעלה his (Jacob’s) image in heaven (Gen. R. s. 68 איקונין). Sot. 36
<sup>b</sup> באת דמות דיוקנו וכ' Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. באתה דיוקנו) a vision resembling his father’s countenance appeared; Tanḥ. Vayesh. 9; a. fr.—Sabb. 149
<sup>a</sup> דְּיוֹקְנָה עצמה the statue itself.—
<plural-form>Pl. דְּיוֹקְנָאוֹת</plural-form> (fr. דיוקני). Sabb. l. c.; Tosef. ib. XVII (XVIII), 1 ed. Zuck. (Var. הַיִּקְנָאוֹת, בַּיִּיקְנָאוֹת) 
<italic>statues, busts</italic>, differ. fr. צורה painting (Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42
<sup>b</sup> bot. אִיקוֹנִיּוֹת). B. Mets. 115
<sup>a</sup> שכר ד' remuneration for pictures(?)</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="D00540">
<head-word>*דְּיוּקְתָּא</head-word>

<italic>the examination of family records required for pure marriages</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="B00154">בָּדַק</xref>); in gen. 
<italic>family record</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 59
<sup>b</sup> (prov.) דזקיף … בדְיוּקְתֵּיה וכ', quot. Yalk. Ex. 349 (ed. בדיותקיה, Ms. M. בריסתקי, Ms. H. בדוּקְתֵּיה, Ms. F. בדותקיה, &c., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if there is a case of hanging in one’s family record, say not to him, Hang this fish up for me. [Sh’ilt. d’R. Aḥai s. 41 has three times דוקתא, s. 153 דותקא. For the etymol. of דיותקא, דות', v. Perl. Et. St. p. 80.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<plural-form>Pl. דְּיוֹרִים, דְּיוֹרִין</plural-form>. Ib. ד' ממש real lodging places, ראוי' לד' fit for shelter. Tosef. ib. X (VII), 12; a. fr. V. דִּיר.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (דור) 
<italic>inhabitant, lodger, tenant</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Maasr. II, 50
<sup>d</sup> top, opp. to בעה"ב landlord; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. דַּיּוֹרִים, דַּיּוֹרִין, דַּיָּירִין</plural-form>. Succ. I, 2. Ib. 10

<italic>dayyorin</italic>
<italic>?</italic> Do you mean that no dwellers occupy the upper story?—Does the fitness of a residence depend on the existence of real dwellers?—Gen. R. s. 28; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (דחי) 
<italic>suspension, removal of a consecrated object from its purpose; disability</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 7
<sup>b</sup>; Zeb. 12
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. די מעיקרא חוי ד' a primary disability (existing at the time of the vow) is considered like a removal (through a cause of a later date), (opp. to נראה ונדחה, v. דָּחָה Nif.). Ib. יש ד' בדמים the law concerning suspension or removal applies also to such objects as are consecrated only for the value they represent; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. דִּיחוּיִין, דִּח'</plural-form>. Yoma 63
<sup>b</sup> דלית ליה ד' who rejects the opinion concerning unfitness (of the scape-goat on account of an accident to the sacrificial goat). Zeb. 12
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>law-suit, claim; judgment, justice, law</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 92
<sup>a</sup>; Snh. 6
<sup>b</sup> יקוב הד' את ההר let the law cut through the mountain (justice under all circumstances). Ib. 2
<sup>b</sup> אין דִּינֵיהֶם ד' their decision is not binding. Keth. IX, 2 אין מרחמין בד' compassion must have no influence on the decision of the law. Ib. IX, 1 ד' ודברים אין לי וכ' I have no claim whatever &c. Snh. l. c. שנים שבאו לד' two persons who come before court. Ib. VI, 1, v. גָּמַר.—B. Mets. 30
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. ד' תורה strict law, opp. לפנים משורת הד' inside the line of the law, 
<italic>equity</italic>.—Sabb. 33
<sup>a</sup> עינוי הד' vexations of the law, unnecessary delay of sentence, עיוות הד' perversion of the law, partiality and sophistry; קילקול הד' disregard of the law, wrong sentence through carelessness.—Ab. Zar. 18
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. יום הד' the day of judgment (in the world to come). Ib., a. fr. הצדיק את הד' to declare God’s judgment right, to submit to God’s decree with resignation, צידוק הד' resignation.—Ab. IV, 22, a. fr. נתן ד' to give an account, to be made responsible.—Gen. R. s. 28 נטלו דִינָם suffered punishment Ib. s. 22 לתבוע דִּינוֹ של וכ' (Ar. דקיון) to make responsible for &c., cmp. דִּיקְיֹון; a. fr.—Ib. s. 12 end, a. fr. מידת הד' the attribute of justice, Divine Justice, opp. מידת הרחמים Divine Mercy; v. מִדָּה.—בֵּית דִּין (abbr. ב"ד) court, v. בַּיִת.—גְּזַר ד' decree, v. גָּזָר.—Kidd. 65
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. בעל ד' litigant, opponent in court.—Snh. 32
<sup>b</sup> ד' מרומה proceedings in court which bear evidences of fraudulent claims or statements.—Ber. 55
<sup>a</sup> מוסר ד' על חבירו וכ' one who appeals to the Lord for judgment on his neighbor.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>argument, analogy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 4
<sup>b</sup>; Zeb. 38
<sup>a</sup> מפני הד' by analogy from equal expressions, v. גְּזֵרָה. Ib. והלא ד' הוא is not this an analogy?—Esp. 
<italic>conclusion from minor to major</italic> (קל וְחֹומֶר). Y. Kidd. I, beg. 58
<sup>b</sup>; Bab. ib. 4
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. ד' הוא it is a proper conclusion; מה … אינו ד' if a Hebrew hand-maid … is acquired by means of money, אינו ד' וכ' is it not so much the more proper that a wife &c.—Snh. 54
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. אין עונשין מן הד' the tresspass of a law derived by conclusion 
<italic>ad majus</italic> is not punishable.—לבא מן הד' וכ', v. דַּי.—Snh. 2
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. ובד' הוא ד־ and by right &c. Ib. הוא הד' דאפי' the same applies also to &c.—

<sup>a</sup>.—Snh. IV, 1, a. fr. דיני ממונות civil cases, ד' נפשות capital cases. R. Hash. 21
<sup>b</sup> ד' שבלב שלא וכ' sentences from a mere inner conviction, without witnesses &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
